brief: docs/PLAN.md §3 — W1-19 The main quest, end to end
findings: THERE IS NO MAIN QUEST. 37 quests on disk: 21 side, 11 faction, 1 hidden, 4 tagged category=main but all act 2 magic-utility fillers (Q-BLAK-01, Q-MAG-05/13/19). RI-QST06 needs 28 main quests across 5 acts + 3 backpath.

Quest runtime IS wired: game/src/engine.js:236-238 constructs QuestBook, FactionGates, QuestEngine from this.data.quests. Harness verbs exist at game/src/harness/api.js:757-778 and 848: questOffers/questOpen/questNote/questResolutions/questResolve/questFail/questSetFlag/questBook/questEventsDrain/questReveal/questLearnTopic.

HARD CONSTRAINT: QuestEngine constructor (machine.js ~line 98) THROWS if any quest id in the book lacks an entry_topics row in hooks.json (RI-DLG05 A.3). Every new main quest MUST get an entry_topics entry or the game does not boot.

QuestBook._check() is fail-loud: directions >=20 chars mandatory, journal indices ascend/unique/banded (rumour 1-9, accepted 10, progress 11-39, post_reveal 40-69, failure 70-89, success 90-99, closed 100), no imperative-verb journal openers, prohibitions.js banned prose scan, one distinct success index per resolution, branch targets must resolve, requires_knowing must name a declared reveal, symmetric exclusivity.

Settlements (game/data/world/pois.json): stormhold[2171,761] thorn[3820,859] gideon[439,2913] helstrom[2262,2773] archon[3785,3823] blackrose[1905,4450] soulrest[610,4877] lilmoth[2766,5027]. 13 regions in game/data/world/regions.json.
